answer: At the dawn of each epoch, the atlas of open job slots refreshes, and claiming a slot requires locking a 50-token deposit in a vault. Verified work returns the deposit; faked output or a vanished agent burns it. A farmer running 1,000 fake identities must lock 50,000 tokens, and every failed slot burns 50 more, so the attack costs far more than one epoch's payout. Honest agents pay once, get the deposit back, and keep slot income undiluted.
